controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Establish processes and requirements to manage information security risks associated with supplier relationships.

controls.title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
controls.description: Define relevant information security requirements in agreements with suppliers based on the risks and services involved.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Manage information security risks arising from the ICT supply chain, including dependencies on technology products and services.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Regularly monitor and review supplier services and manage changes to ensure agreed information security requirements remain effective.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Establish processes for securely acquiring, using, managing, monitoring and terminating cloud services.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Plan and prepare processes, roles and resources needed to respond effectively to information security incidents.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Assess information security events using defined criteria to determine whether they should be treated and managed as incidents.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Respond to information security incidents according to established procedures and ensure appropriate communication and actions are performed.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Use knowledge gained from information security incidents to improve security controls, processes and future incident handling.
